qa.user_verbatim_complaint: 文件和图片顶部宽度和左右宽度仍然不统一。此外文件太大了无法上传并且没有报错
qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: Bug A: Measured image chip (small.png) and file chip (hello.txt) in the running app; both render pixel-identical 64x64 thumbnails with 8px border-radius, identical 64px chip width, identical 8px marginRight gutter, identical outer chip box (64x77px). The shared THUMB_SIZE=64 constant and CHIP_GUTTER=8 constant in AttachmentStrip.tsx mean there is a single source of truth. Verified on BOTH mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x800). Bug B: Paste of 11 MB file triggers a modal.alert (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) titled 'Error' with message 'File exceeds 10 MB limit. Please choose a smaller file.' and OK button. The oversize file is NOT added to the tray (persistedCount unchanged). This satisfies §5.12.2 'silent oversize-upload failure' requirement.

qa.overall_assessment: Both Bug A (layout inconsistency) and Bug B (silent oversize upload) are resolved. Measurements confirm pixel-identical chip layout across image and file attachment types, at both mobile and desktop viewports. Oversize upload triggers a visible, localized error modal with actionable corrective text. hasErrorAttachments / send-time block logic is code-verified in useComposerSend. The dev implementation matches the BA spec.

success_criteria_results.source_phrase: send button is blocked/alerts when an attachment is in error state
success_criteria_results.criterion: §5.12.3 (follow-on): useComposerSend blocks send when hasErrorAttachments is true.
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code inspection of SessionView.tsx useComposerSend (lines 462-478): explicitly guards 'if (att.hasErrorAttachments) { Modal.alert(...); return; }' BEFORE att.clearAttachments(). hasErrorAttachments memo in useAttachments.ts:247-250 checks attachments.some(a => a.status === 'error'). The oversize code path rejects BEFORE adding to tray (no error chip possible from oversize), so this guard catches network/MIME upload failures only. Not live-reproducible without network fault injection.
success_criteria_results.details: Code path is correctly wired. In this test environment all uploads succeeded (status=ready); triggering a real upload failure requires network fault injection outside QA's scope. Logic is verified in source (SessionView.tsx:467-470 + useAttachments.ts:247-250).
success_criteria_results.evidence: Code inspection: SessionView.tsx:462-478, useAttachments.ts:242-252. dev-report.json task 2.

qa._success_criteria_rule: BA decomposed §5.12 into 3 acceptance points (layout, silent oversize, visible error). All 3 verified.

root_cause_verification.rationale: Layout: dev introduced THUMB_SIZE=64 (AttachmentStrip.tsx:61) and CHIP_GUTTER=8 (line 62) as single-source-of-truth constants, replacing the divergent values from auto-commit f6f129a1. Reverted overlay.left:4->0. Normalized strip padding to paddingHorizontal:12 + paddingVertical:8. Measurements confirm application. Error surfacing: useAttachments.ts lines 168, 185, 198 all invoke rejectedRef.current?.('oversize') instead of silent return. SessionView.tsx:482-488 wires the handler to Modal.alert with locale-appropriate text. Verified live.
